title: I vibed a proof of Conway's conjecture
summary: A Hacker News discussion about a GitHub repository where developer Dan Abramov (gaearon) used AI-assisted 'vibe coding' to produce a purported proof of Conway's conjecture. The thread debates the validity of the proof, the role of LLMs in mathematical reasoning, and whether AI-generated proofs constitute genuine mathematical work or merely plausible-looking text.
